headword: {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}

definitions.gloss: made-to-order production, build-to-order, production on demand
definitions.explanation: A manufacturing system where products are made only after receiving a customer's order, rather than being mass-produced in advance. Contrasts with {見込|みこ}み{生産|せいさん} (speculative production / make-to-stock).

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}は{注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}で{運営|うんえい}されている。
examples.english: This factory operates on a made-to-order basis.

examples.japanese: {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}なので、{納期|のうき}は2{週間|しゅうかん}かかります。
examples.english: Since it's made to order, delivery takes two weeks.

examples.japanese: {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}{方式|ほうしき}を{採用|さいよう}することで、{在庫|ざいこ}リスクを{減|へ}らすことができる。
examples.english: By adopting a build-to-order system, inventory risk can be reduced.

notes:
A compound of {注文|ちゅうもん} (order) + {生産|せいさん} (production). Also called {受注生産|じゅちゅうせいさん}, which is perhaps slightly more formal. Common in manufacturing, business, and IT (e.g., Dell's build-to-order computer model).

The opposite concept is {見込|みこ}み{生産|せいさん} (make-to-stock), where goods are produced in advance based on demand forecasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}{方式|ほうしき}: made-to-order system
- {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}で{作|つく}る: to make to order
- {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}{品|ひん}: made-to-order products

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受注生産|じゅちゅうせいさん}: production upon order receipt — essentially synonymous, slightly more formal
- {見込|みこ}み{生産|せいさん}: make-to-stock production — the opposite; producing in advance
- {量産|りょうさん}: mass production — large-scale production, typically not custom
